title: Ankhorage Secrets
summary: Defines provider-neutral secret-store capability descriptors and portable secret-store contract entrypoints.
purpose: Let independent applications and adapters discover value-free secret metadata operations without coupling to a particular secret-store provider.
responsibilities: Publish capability descriptors for listing and reading secret metadata without exposing secret values.
Expose the canonical secret-store contract types and normalization helpers at a dedicated public subpath.
Describe the secret scope, reference, provider, kind, and configured-field shapes used by capability consumers.
boundaries: Does not store, resolve, create, replace, or remove secret values.
Does not implement a provider-specific secret-store adapter.
Does not grant secret access or decide application authorization policy.
audience: Applications and tooling that discover secret metadata operations.
Provider adapter authors implementing the portable secret-store contract.
useCases: Discover the supported list and metadata capability shapes before binding a secret-store provider.
Import portable secret-store types and normalization helpers through the package port entrypoint.
Present configured secret metadata without exposing secret payload values.

architecture.role: Provider-neutral capability catalog and contract facade for secret-store integrations.
invariants: Capability descriptors are value-free and do not expose secret payloads.
Provider-specific behavior remains behind independently implemented secret-store adapters.
Consumers use published capability and port subpaths rather than sibling source imports.

limitations: The package describes only list and metadata discovery operations as executable capabilities.
Secret values and provider credentials remain outside this package.
